verses.text: This is a message from the LORD about Israel. The LORD, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of people inside them, says:
"Look, I will make Jerusalem like a cup that makes all the surrounding peoples stagger. Judah will be caught up in the siege against Jerusalem too.
On that day I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples. Anyone who tries to move it will be badly hurt. All the nations of the earth will gather against it.

On that day," says the LORD, "I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness. I will watch over the people of Judah, and I will strike every horse of the other nations with blindness.
Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts, 'The people of Jerusalem are our strength through the LORD of Armies, their God.'

On that day I will make the leaders of Judah like a firepot among wood and like a flaming torch among sheaves of grain. They will burn up all the surrounding peoples on the right and on the left. Jerusalem will stay safe in its own place again.
The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of David's family and the glory of Jerusalem's people will not be greater than that of Judah.
On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem. Even the weakest among them will be like David, and David's family will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

I will pour out on David's family and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of kindness and prayer. They will look at me, the one they have pierced. They will mourn for him as people mourn for an only child, and they will cry bitterly for him as people cry for a firstborn son.
On that day there will be great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadad Rimmon in the valley of Megiddo.
The whole land will mourn, each family by itself: the family of David's house by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of Nathan's house by itself, and their wives by themselves;
the family of Levi's house by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of the Shimeites by itself, and their wives by themselves;
and all the other families that are left, each by itself, and their wives by themselves.
